name: Joseph of Arimathea
title: The one who buried Jesus
summary: Joseph of Arimathea was a wealthy and respected member of the Council, but secretly a disciple of Jesus. He had not agreed to the Council's decision to kill Jesus. After the crucifixion, he took courage, went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body, which he laid in his own new tomb.

keyEvents.title: Waiting for God's kingdom
keyEvents.description: Joseph was a good and righteous man who waited for God's kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Asked for Jesus' body
keyEvents.description: Joseph took courage and went to Pilate to ask for Jesus' body.

keyEvents.title: The burial
keyEvents.description: Joseph laid Jesus' body in his own new tomb, hewn out of the rock.
